# Thresholds

Every number this package decides on: the boundaries, not the
coefficients. A coefficient out of a specification table is correct and
nobody argues about it. These are the ones an agency changes.

| module                        | name                         | value                                             | what it means                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| shearstud.analysis.fatiguerun | MAX_CREDITED_LIFE_YEARS      | `100.0`                                           | The most fatigue life the interval rule is allowed to be told about. An infinite life is a statement about one calculation and not about the structure, and it must not walk into a programme decision as a number no threshold can ever fail.                                                     |
| shearstud.analysis.programrun | UNMEASURED_LIFE_YEARS        | `100.0`                                           | What an unmeasured structure's fatigue life is taken to be. Above every threshold in the banding, so the absence of a measurement never puts a structure into the retrofit band on its own.                                                                                                        |
| shearstud.analysis.recordrun  | MIN_TRIGGER_UE               | `15.0`                                            | Smallest trigger worth using, whatever the fraction works out to. A quiet night on a quiet route has a peak of four microstrain and triggering at a third of that finds four hundred events in the noise.                                                                                          |
| shearstud.fatigue.evaluation  | MIN_CAMPAIGN_DAYS            | `7.0`                                             | A campaign shorter than this cannot see a weekly traffic cycle and its extrapolation is a guess wearing a number.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| shearstud.fatigue.evaluation  | RETROFIT_YEARS               | `5.0`                                             | Remaining life below this many years puts the detail on the list for a retrofit rather than another inspection.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| shearstud.fatigue.evaluation  | WATCH_YEARS                  | `20.0`                                            | Remaining life below this many years is worth a shorter inspection interval.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

A three girder cross section is outside them and wants the lever rule instead, which is why this refuses rather than extrapolating.                                                                                                   |
